title: PostScript ingestion host
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-cli --test cli create_postscript and cargo test -p pdfxi-convert postscript_pdf pass; pdfxi create postscript writes a real PDF from DSC input, reopens and extracts captured text, and reports/rejects unsupported constructs; CREATE-013 moves to verified.
notes: Adds the missing PsContent-to-PDF writer (standard Type 1 fonts, text/rect/line content streams, deterministic objects) and exposes ingest_postscript through the CLI.
